title: Roster Stat-Based Filtering System
description: Add stat-based filtering capability to the Roster component on /roster page, enabling users to filter residents by their stats (e.g., HP, damage, stamina) in addition to existing sorting functionality.
objectives: Add UI controls to select/filter by stats (HP, damage, stamina, etc.)
Implement filtering logic that filters residents by selected stat criteria before sorting
Maintain existing sorting functionality (name, HP, fatigue)
Integrate with existing config-first architecture and resident data sources
Ensure accessibility, theming, and drag-drop compatibility remain intact
Provide clear feedback when no residents match filters
success_criteria: Users can filter roster by stat (e.g., HP > 50, damage > 20)
Filtering works in combination with existing sort modes
All UI labels use i18n (no hardcoded strings)
Filter configuration is config-first with Zod validation
Existing drag-drop and assignment logic unaffected
Lint, build:check, and kanban:lint safeguards pass
integration_points: RosterSortControl.tsx - extend or create companion filter control
rosterSortConfig.ts - create rosterFilterConfig.ts following same pattern
ResidentState.statSnapshot - data source for stat values

invariants: Config-first: All filter options and thresholds from config modules with Zod schemas
i18n: All user-facing strings through react-i18next (idleVillage namespace)
Skin system: Use existing primitives from atoms/fantasy atoms, no new CSS files
Component reuse: Check existing primitives before creating new components
State management: Filter state as local UI state (Context), not domain state (Zustand)
trusted_frozen_components: VillageRosterSection - canonical roster wrapper (verify before modification)
ResidentRosterPanel - canonical roster display (verify before modification)
RosterSortControl - existing sort control (extend, do not break)
forbidden_actions: Do not remove or alter existing sorting controls except to integrate filtering
Do not bypass config-first principles (no hardcoded stat names or thresholds)
Do not modify drag-drop logic or slot assignment
Do not create standalone .css files for styling
Do not use direct localStorage/sessionStorage for filter state

files_to_modify: src/ui/idleVillage/components/RosterSortControl.tsx - add filter control or create companion
public/locales/en/idleVillage.json - add i18n keys for filter UI
public/locales/pseudo/idleVillage.json - add pseudo-locale keys for testing
component_reuse_requirements: Check src/ui/fantasy/atoms/ for fantasy-themed UI primitives
Reuse QuestDecisionHeatmapFilter patterns if applicable (FilterGroup, multi-select)
Use existing input primitives instead of creating new ones

unit_tests: Test filter logic with various stat thresholds
Test edge cases (no residents match, all residents match, empty filters)
integration_tests: Test filter persistence across UI interactions
Test drag-drop compatibility with active filters
accessibility_tests: Screen reader announcements for filter changes
ARIA labels on all filter inputs

documentation_updates: Update idle_village_plan.md with stat filtering feature
Add JSDoc to all new functions and interfaces
Document filter configuration schema in rosterFilterConfig.ts

notes.architecture_approach: Create rosterFilterConfig.ts following rosterSortConfig.ts pattern. Define available stats (from StatBlock keys), operators (>, <, =, >=, <=), and thresholds. Use React Context for filter state (local UI state). Apply filtering in VillageRosterSection before sorting: filterResidents(residents, filterCriteria) -> sortResidents(filtered, sortMode).
notes.stat_block_integration: Residents have statSnapshot: Partial<StatBlock>. Filter by checking statSnapshot[statKey] against threshold with operator. Handle missing stats gracefully (treat as 0 or exclude based on config).
notes.ui_pattern: Simple dropdown for stat selection, dropdown for operator, number input for threshold. Optional: multi-select for stats, range sliders for thresholds. Start simple, enhance based on user feedback.
notes.i18n_keys: Add keys: roster.filter.label, roster.filter.stat.{statName}, roster.filter.operator.{operator}, roster.filter.threshold, roster.filter.clear, roster.filter.noResults
notes.fallback_behavior: If no filters active, show all residents. If no residents match, show 'No residents match current filters' message (i18n). Clear filters button to reset.
notes.drag_drop_compatibility: Filtering only affects display, not underlying resident data. Drag-drop works on filtered list normally. Assignment validation uses full resident data.
